mutants.description: A host read clears fault_reg only when the record is non-empty, on the belief that an empty record has nothing to clear, so a cause live on the read clock is captured through the read instead of losing to the clear
mutants.reason: Suppose a host read of an empty record lands on the same clock as a new cause while the converter runs. fault_reg takes the cause's bit on that clock instead of one clock later. fault_time is still cleared by the read, and fault_reg is non-empty on the next clock, so episode_start never fires. The port shows a non-empty fault_reg with fault_time stuck at zero.

mutants.description: When deciding whether the record is empty, the episode detector ignores the LATCH_ASSERT bit, as if the sticky CPLD trip were background state rather than an open episode
mutants.reason: latch_assert rises while the converter runs, and fault_reg then holds only LATCH. Because latch_assert is held, episode_start stays true on every clock until the supervisor leaves S_SS/S_RUN, so fault_time gets the time of the last running clock instead of the trip time.
